scope: Reconstructed rules; not an official judge result or reproduction of the original generator.

functional_verification.oracle: Independent integer unit-cell four-neighbor flood fill; public API only.

illustrative_random_benchmark.distribution: Our illustrative distribution, not the original problem generator: independent uniform integer widths/heights 1..30; lower corners uniform among in-board placements conditional on dimensions; reject positive-area interior overlap.

runs.timing_includes: API calls, loop/call overhead, and result comparisons against already computed answers.
runs.timing_excludes: Input generation, overlap rejection, reference answer calculation, scan/bucket statistics, data loading, imports, process startup, and file I/O.
runs.time_limit_claim: No official 50-case / 6-second acceptance claim. This dataset uses our own distribution; hardware/runtime and the original generation rules can differ.
